title: ALOX15-Driven Ferroptosis: The key target in Dihydrotanshinone I's epigenetic Battle in hepatic stellate cells against liver fibrosis.
authors: Shen, Ningzhe; Li, Mengyuan; Fang, Binbo; Li, Xinmiao; Jiang, Feng; Zhu, Tingdi; Zheng, Jianjian; Zhang, Weizhi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究DHI通过EGR1/DNMT1/ALOX15表观遗传通路促进肝星状细胞铁死亡抗肝纤维化，虽涉及DNA甲基化与分子对接，但核心是细胞表型与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: It is known that ferroptosis promotes hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) inactivation. Arachidonate 15-Lipoxygenase (ALOX15), a ferroptosis driver gene, participates in disease progression. PURPOSE: Dihydrotanshinone I (DHI), an active compound from Salvia miltiorrhiza, effectively regulates HSC inactivation. Nonetheless, there still needs to be clear understanding of how DHI affects HSC ferroptosis. METHODS: This study primarily investigates DHI's protective effects on liver fibrosis in vivo and in vitro. Additionally, we explored the molecular mechanisms by which DHI promotes ferroptosis in HSCs. The relationship between ALOX15 level and methylation was examined. Molecular docking was performed to confirm the targeting between early growth response protein 1 (EGR1) and DHI. RESULTS: DHI exhibited a mitigating effect on liver fibrosis in vivo. DHI-induced inactivation of HSC by promoting ferroptosis, accompanied by an elevation in intracellular iron and reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels. Results of transcriptome sequencing and quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR) confirmed the elevation of ALOX15 (a ferroptosis driver gene) in HSCs with DHI. Loss of ALOX15 inhibited DHI-induced ferroptosis. Interestingly, DNA methyltransferase 1 (DNMT1), an essential DNA methyltransferase, was downregulated by DHI. Overexpression of DNMT1 resulted in decreased ALOX15 expression in cells with DHI. Notably, transcription factor EGR1 was demonstrated to regulate DNMT1 expression. EGR1 deficiency led to an increase in DNMT1 expression, which inhibited DHI-induced ferroptosis. Molecular docking confirmed that EGR1 could serve as a direct pharmacological target of DHI. CONCLUSION: DHI upregulates EGR1 level, leading to decreased DNMT1 expression and increased ALOX15 demethylation, thereby promoting HSC ferroptosis and inactivation.
abstract_zh: 背景：已知铁死亡（ferroptosis）促进肝星状细胞（HSCs）失活。花生四烯酸15-脂氧合酶（ALOX15）作为铁死亡驱动基因，参与疾病进展。目的：二氢丹参酮I（DHI）是丹参（Salvia miltiorrhiza）中的活性化合物，能有效调节HSC失活。然而，DHI如何影响HSC铁死亡的机制仍需明确。方法：本研究主要探讨DHI在体内和体外对肝纤维化的保护作用。此外，我们探索了DHI促进HSC铁死亡的分子机制。检测了ALOX15水平与甲基化之间的关系。通过分子对接（molecular docking）确认早期生长反应蛋白1（EGR1）与DHI之间的靶向作用。结果：DHI在体内对肝纤维化表现出缓解作用。DHI通过促进铁死亡诱导HSC失活，伴随细胞内铁和活性氧（ROS）水平升高。转录组测序和实时定量PCR（qRT-PCR）结果证实，DHI处理下HSC中ALOX15（铁死亡驱动基因）表达升高。ALOX15缺失抑制了DHI诱导的铁死亡。有趣的是，DNA甲基转移酶1（DNMT1）作为一种关键DNA甲基转移酶，被DHI下调。DNMT1过表达导致DHI处理细胞中ALOX15表达降低。值得注意的是，转录因子EGR1被证明可调控DNMT1表达。EGR1缺失导致DNMT1表达增加，从而抑制DHI诱导的铁死亡。分子对接证实EGR1可作为DHI的直接药理学靶点。结论：DHI上调EGR1水平，导致DNMT1表达降低和ALOX15去甲基化增加，从而促进HSC铁死亡和失活。
